summary: The core chord implementation, production defaults, deterministic representative-plane ordering, primary batch/report fields, and focused synthetic tests are credible. Acceptance is blocked because the v5.7.1 tuner still calculates and serializes unqualified width metrics from the superseded EDT measurement, and all-unavailable tracks receive an unstable output schema rather than explicit unavailable representative-width fields. Fresh focused pytest execution was also prevented by the read-only environment's lack of a usable temporary directory.

evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8035-8169 routes command-line single-image processing through measure_spermatids, rows_from_results, and the single-slice summary.

sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8189-8401 implements headless batch processing; sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:15982-16295 and 16307-16623 implement GUI slice and GUI batch paths using the same measurement and reporting functions.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13710-13831 routes study-manager specimens through process_batch.

utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:535-539 computes tuner widths from legacy width_px and length_width_ratio instead of body_width_px and length_body_width_ratio; lines 764-774 exports them under unqualified median_width_um and median_length_width_ratio names.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3387-3457 returns deterministic median, P90, IQR, sample count, method, and unavailable NaN values when fewer than BODY_WIDTH_MIN_SAMPLES chords succeed.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3515-3574 measures the filled U-Net instance mask and preserves EDT results as width_px_dt_median_legacy and length_width_ratio_dt_legacy.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:4778-4825 serializes body_width_px/body_width_um separately from explicitly labelled EDT legacy fields.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:5125-5175 uses stable mergesort ordering by track, descending filled-mask area, descending U-Net support, and ascending Z.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:5178-5201 maps the selected plane to representative body-width fields and computes the primary ratio.

However, sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:5118-5134 returns the input track table unchanged when every detection has unavailable width, so representative_body_width_um, representative_width_sample_count, representative_width_method, and length_body_width_ratio can disappear rather than being serialized as explicitly unavailable.

tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:139-150 tests unavailable slice measurement, but no test exercises an all-unavailable track through _attach_representative_body_width or the resulting track CSV/report schema.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:293-297 defaults to BODY_WIDTH_ENABLE=true, endpoint trim 0.125, spacing 1.0 px, smoothing 1.0 px, and minimum 5 samples.
production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:88-92 contains the same values.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:16699-16718 loads and validates that reviewed profile by default; lines 16739-16761 apply the same profile behavior to GUI, single-image, and batch CLI execution.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:5165-5175 uses stable mergesort and a documented lowest-Z final tie-break, avoiding row-order-dependent representative widths.
The chord implementation at sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3387-3457 contains no random sampling or device-dependent inference operation.

U-Net probability caching is upstream of measurement; rows are remeasured through measure_spermatids and rows_from_results rather than caching body-width outputs, as traced at sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8035-8163 and utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:878.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:16699-16714 derives the production profile from PROJECT_ROOT rather than the process working directory.

tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:58-73 covers known-width masks at 0, 20, 45, 70, and 90 degrees; lines 76-99 cover endpoint trimming; lines 102-136 cover U-Net measurement and legacy/new exports; lines 153-200 cover largest-area selection and deterministic ties.
tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:203-226 verifies the analysis summary selects body width and explicitly labels legacy EDT width.

No focused test verifies tuner summary field selection, GUI/batch generated CSV columns, report generation from an all-unavailable-width population, profile-loaded execution, cache replay, or compatibility of missing-width track schemas.

The rotation test asserts each angle independently against a broad absolute tolerance but does not directly bound maximum cross-angle bias, allowing a 1.6 px extreme-to-extreme spread while every assertion passes.

Command .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests\test_saturn_v571_body_width.py failed before collection with FileNotFoundError: No usable temporary directory found; the required validated virtual environment was used.

audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md records 237 passing tests and a passing tuner self-check, but identifies production code commit 6f9e73b170db121460ab82f28542d1ed1e8f96bb rather than reviewed commit 1ac87a958cb6ff3b83588617e48e40b1e8035c19.

git log reports sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py was subsequently changed at 0459af857bb65033a77e7bc097e577b1b1a6f14d, so the receipt's production-code identity is not sufficient proof of the complete reviewed source state.

git status --short --untracked-files=all reports the entire audits/runs/20260827-v571-body-width-acceptance-final directory as untracked, plus an untracked visual_evidence review generated during the audit.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json embeds absolute C:\Users\dmishra\Desktop\sperm_project paths for study and report outputs, which are not portable to the reviewed workspace.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_source_binding.json likewise records generation paths outside the repository, although it also provides retained artifact hashes.

findings.title: The v5.7.1 tuner exposes superseded EDT width under primary-looking names
findings.impact: Tuner workspaces and candidate summaries can present median_width_um and median_length_width_ratio as current metrics even though they are computed from the legacy quantized EDT width. This contradicts the claim that contour-chord body width is primary and violates the requirement that legacy measurements remain explicitly labelled.
evidence: utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:535-539 reads width_px and length_width_ratio from raw result records.

utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:764-774 exports those values as median_width_um, median_length_width_ratio, wide_object_fraction, and low_length_width_ratio_fraction without legacy qualification.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3568-3574 establishes width_px and length_width_ratio as EDT legacy semantics while body_width_px and length_body_width_ratio are the replacement fields.

The tuner self-check at utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:1984-1991 constructs only legacy width_px/length_width_ratio records, making the check self-fulfilling and unable to detect this mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Use body_width_px and length_body_width_ratio for primary tuner summaries, propagate unavailable values without substitution, and rename any retained EDT diagnostics with explicit _dt_legacy names. Add a regression test containing intentionally divergent body and EDT widths.

findings.title: All-unavailable tracks lose the representative-width schema
findings.impact: Track CSVs and downstream integrations receive different columns depending on whether any width succeeds. Consumers cannot reliably distinguish an intentionally unavailable measurement from an older producer that never implemented the field.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:5118-5134 returns track_summary without initializing representative fields when the input is empty, lacks body_width_um, or has no finite positive widths.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:5178-5201 creates representative fields only after at least one candidate survives.
tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:139-150 stops at slice-level NaN behavior and does not exercise all-unavailable track serialization.
findings.recommendation: Initialize the complete representative-width schema for every track with NaN, zero sample count, and an explicit unavailable method before candidate selection; add track CSV and report tests for zero, partial, and complete width availability.

findings.title: Commit-bound validation does not identify the final production source commit
findings.impact: The retained receipt cannot by itself demonstrate that the exact reviewed source and tests passed, especially because the pipeline file changed after the receipt's stated production commit.
evidence: audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md names 6f9e73b170db121460ab82f28542d1ed1e8f96bb as the production code commit.
git log -1 -- sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py reports 0459af857bb65033a77e7bc097e577b1b1a6f14d.
Fresh focused pytest execution failed before collection because the managed environment exposed no writable temporary directory.
findings.recommendation: Run the focused and full suites against the exact final source commit in the validated virtual environment, record the exact commit and source/profile hashes in a superseding receipt, and retain machine-readable command output.

findings.title: Committed report metadata contains non-portable absolute paths
findings.impact: Automated replay or artifact discovery on another workstation can fail or resolve unrelated local files despite content hashes being available.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json records study_output and report paths under C:\Users\dmishra\Desktop\sperm_project.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_source_binding.json records source_study_output and tracking_replay as workstation-specific absolute paths.
findings.recommendation: Store repository-relative retained-artifact paths as authoritative identifiers and retain original execution paths only in a clearly labelled provenance field.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as instructed.
Focused pytest could not start because the managed read-only environment had no usable temporary directory; test conclusions combine source inspection with the committed validation receipt.
Other reviewers' outputs were not used as evidence. A broad initial search inadvertently displayed fragments from unrelated retained audit files; those fragments were disregarded.
GUI interaction and GPU inference were not executed; their code paths were traced statically.
The untracked current audit-run files may change while reviewers are running and are not treated as commit-bound claim evidence.
recommended_follow_up: Correct the tuner to use primary body-width fields and explicitly label all retained EDT diagnostics.
Stabilize representative-width columns for all-unavailable tracks and add end-to-end CSV/report regression coverage.
Rerun focused and full validation against the exact corrected commit with an explicit writable basetemp, then create a superseding audit run.
